clue.text: Fellows gather round to help a girl

indicators.note: the fellows gather round, so their word encloses the other piece

parts.note: fellows are men
to help is to aid

explanation.surface: A group of men rally round to assist a young woman.
explanation.definitionFit: A maiden is an old word for a young unmarried woman.

clue.text: The most important guy on board

definitions.text: The most important guy on board

parts.words: The most important guy on board
parts.note: reads like the top person on a company board, but a guy is also a supporting rope, and on board ship the chief such rope from the mainmast

explanation.definitionFit: A ship's chief stay supports the mainmast, and figuratively the word means a chief support.

clue.text: Dog entered in races is withdrawn

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: the dog has entered the races, so its name goes inside the letters for races

parts.note: TT, the Tourist Trophy motorcycle races on the Isle of Man
Rover is a traditional name for a dog

explanation.surface: A greyhound running in races turns out to be shy.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone withdrawn is shy and inward-looking, the classic introvert.

clue.text: Greek character bestriding N. Italian mount

indicators.note: the Greek letter straddles the abbreviation, its letters falling either side

parts.note: eta is a letter of the Greek alphabet
N is the abbreviation for north

explanation.surface: A Greek figure sits astride a mountain in northern Italy.
explanation.definitionFit: Etna is the volcano in Sicily, an Italian mountain.

clue.text: Reserve given regular role as player

parts.note: set, as in a set routine, means regular or fixed
an actor's role is a part, here 'a part'

explanation.surface: A reserve player is promised a regular spot in the team.
explanation.definitionFit: To set apart is to reserve or keep something for a special purpose.

clue.text: The converse of friends

parts.note: 'converse' suggests friendly chat, but here it means the opposite of friends

explanation.definitionFit: Foes are the opposite of friends.

clue.text: File data if somehow connected

indicators.note: somehow suggests the letters are put together in some new way

explanation.surface: Filing data turns out to be linked in some way.
explanation.definitionFit: Affiliated means linked or associated with something.

clue.text: Sort of stage for a kitchen-sink play?

definitions.text: Sort of stage for a kitchen-sink play?

parts.words: Sort of stage for a kitchen-sink play?
parts.note: a theatre stage extending in front of the curtain, and also what is worn for kitchen work

explanation.walkthrough: A kitchen-sink drama is a British genre of gritty domestic realism; the garment worn at the sink shares its name with a forestage.
explanation.definitionFit: The forestage in front of a proscenium is called by the same name as a cook's protective garment.

clue.text: This religious belief is held by our opponents

indicators.note: the word is is held inside the word for our opponents

parts.note: them, as opposed to us
taken as written

explanation.surface: A faith that the other side professes.
explanation.definitionFit: Belief in a god or gods is the core of a religious creed.

clue.text: Describing Jill when cut off by Edward

definitions.text: Describing Jill when cut off by Edward

indicators.note: Jill is cut off, losing her final letter

parts.note: Ted is a short form of Edward

explanation.surface: Jill, dumped by Edward, is described in one word.
explanation.definitionFit: A woman abandoned by a lover is said to be rejected in this way.

clue.text: Jockey in event is all-in

indicators.note: to jockey is to manoeuvre, so these letters are shifted about

explanation.surface: A jockey in a race is exhausted.
explanation.definitionFit: All-in means thorough or comprehensive, as in all-in or thorough training.

clue.text: It's loud for a musical note

parts.note: taken as written
te is a note of the sol-fa scale

explanation.surface: A loud musical note.
explanation.definitionFit: In music the Italian marking for playing loudly, abbreviated f.

clue.text: Open sea -lower the boat

indicators.note: the opening of the word sea is its first letter

parts.note: a lower is something that lows, as cattle do

explanation.surface: On the open sea, lower the boat.
explanation.definitionFit: A scow is a flat-bottomed barge or boat.

clue.text: Heather undresses without seeing the youths

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so the word for undresses goes around

parts.note: strips means undresses
ling is a common heather

explanation.surface: Heather takes her clothes off without the young men watching.
explanation.definitionFit: Striplings are young lads not yet fully grown.

clue.text: A succession of small bloomers

parts.note: bloomers suggests underwear or blunders, but here means little flowers linked one after another

explanation.definitionFit: A string of small flowers threaded stem to stem, made by children.

clue.text: Be a clumsy fat lover of Heloise

indicators.note: clumsy suggests the letters are handled awkwardly into a new order

parts.note: lard is pig fat

explanation.surface: A suitor is told to be a clumsy, overweight lover.
explanation.definitionFit: Peter Abelard, the medieval French philosopher, had a famous tragic love affair with his pupil Heloise.

clue.text: The opposite of bustles-yet still worn

definitions.meaning: bustles means hurries, and the opposite is idles or eases off
a kind of casual trousers still in fashion, set against the bustle, a dress pad no longer worn

explanation.surface: Unlike the bustle, these garments are still worn today.
explanation.definitionFit: To ease off is the reverse of hurrying, and casual trousers are a wardrobe staple.

clue.text: Thrills with loose woman get things moving

parts.note: kicks means thrills
tart is slang for a promiscuous woman

explanation.surface: Thrill-seeking with a fast woman livens things up.
explanation.definitionFit: To start a motorbike with a kick, and figuratively to jolt something into action.

clue.text: Man's man, for instance

parts.note: a man's man suggests a macho type, but Man is the Isle of Man, and its inhabitant is one example

explanation.walkthrough: The Isle of Man is a self-governing island in the Irish Sea.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who lives on an island, such as the Isle of Man.

clue.text: Assist doctor in blood stoppage

indicators.note: to doctor is to alter or tamper with, so the letters are reworked

explanation.surface: Helping a doctor deal with a blood clot.
explanation.definitionFit: In medicine the term for a halt in the flow of blood or body fluid.

clue.text: Group studying ruined remains

indicators.note: ruined suggests the letters are wrecked and rebuilt

explanation.surface: Archaeology students examine the ruins.
explanation.definitionFit: A tutorial class where a small group discusses a subject.

clue.text: Goes into new recipes

indicators.note: new suggests a fresh arrangement of the letters

explanation.surface: A cook tries out fresh recipes.
explanation.definitionFit: To pierce is to penetrate or enter.

clue.text: Worker to snoop about the butler's domain

indicators.note: the word for snoop goes round about the other piece

parts.note: to pry is to snoop
a worker ant, a classic crossword worker

explanation.surface: A servant pokes around the butler's quarters.
explanation.definitionFit: A pantry is the storeroom traditionally in a butler's charge.

clue.text: Something lyrical about a redhead's garment

indicators.note: the song goes about the other letters, enclosing them

parts.note: a song has lyrics
taken as written
the head of red is its first letter

explanation.surface: A song about a red-haired woman's dress.
explanation.definitionFit: A sarong is a wrapped skirt-like garment worn in South-East Asia.

clue.text: Love sent by -e-mail?

definitions.meaning: a file sent along with an e-mail message

explanation.surface: A love letter delivered electronically.
explanation.definitionFit: Fondness for a person, and a file added to an electronic message, share one word.

clue.text: They meet for a bite

parts.note: sounds like friends meeting for a snack, but upper and lower sets close together when chewing

explanation.definitionFit: Upper and lower ones come together when you chew.

clue.text: Like to get a first-class return for the continent

parts.note: as means like

indicators.note: the letters for first-class are turned back

parts.note: A1 means first-class, written AI

explanation.surface: Wanting a first-class return ticket for a trip abroad.
explanation.definitionFit: Asia is the largest of the world's continents.

clue.text: Lover's knot, say

indicators.note: say signals that the word is spoken

parts.note: a bow is a kind of knot

explanation.surface: A lovers' knot, as it were.
explanation.definitionFit: A beau is a boyfriend or admirer.

clue.text: It may be a soap works

definitions.meaning: a soap is a soap ..., a long-running TV serial
plural of opus, a musical or literary work

explanation.surface: A soap factory.
explanation.definitionFit: Soaps are serial dramas named for this, and the Latin plural of opus means compositions.

clue.text: Mother insured for working outside, her charges are small

indicators.note: the reworked letters sit outside the word for mother
working suggests the letters are set in motion into a new order

parts.note: ma is mother

explanation.surface: A mother insured for working away from home looks after children.
explanation.walkthrough: 'working' rearranges INSURED into NURSEID, placed outside MA.
explanation.definitionFit: A nanny cares for young children, the small charges.

clue.text: Have a fast time

parts.note: suggests a racy good time, but fast here means abstaining from food

explanation.definitionFit: To fast is to do without food.

clue.text: Instrument to pluck from the air, gut also required

indicators.note: pluck from suggests the letters are plucked and rearranged

explanation.surface: An instrument you pluck seems to come from the air, though it needs gut strings.
explanation.definitionFit: A guitar is a stringed instrument.
